narrative.overview: Temporary header and hero with the owner's retained navy/cyan palette and updated domestic boiler-room equipment reference. The scene shows a wall boiler, indirect cylinder, manifolds and tidy small pipework rather than factory machinery. The owner approved the hero direction for this narrow refinement; production adoption and the proposed drop mark remain unapproved. The main site and lower sections remain unchanged; await owner approval before extending this language.
keyCharacteristics: Full-bleed domestic boiler-room environment behind readable left-aligned HTML, with slim left-perimeter pipes and cyan lights.
Midnight navy, cyan and white, with an independent light alternative.
Pill actions and four restrained glass service panels.
